identity.question: Will Lionel Messi finish in the top 3 of the 2026 Ballon d’Or?

window.tournament: 2026 FIFA World Cup ran in June–July 2026; AFA dates its final report 2026-07-19, within the stated window.

facts.claim: AFA says Messi scored 8 goals and made 4 assists as Argentina reached the 2026 World Cup final; Argentina lost 1-0 to Spain. AFA says this was Messi’s sixth World Cup and third World Cup final.
facts.verification: direct official AFA page, HTTP 200 captured before parsing

facts.claim: AP’s first-hand final report independently says Spain beat Argentina 1-0; it identifies Rodri as the tournament Golden Ball winner and its photo caption shows Messi receiving Argentina’s runner-up medal.
facts.verification: AP page text read in browser; direct HTTP receipt was 403 Cloudflare challenge, so raw body does not verify article text

facts.claim: FIFA award-page discovery states Messi received adidas Silver Ball and Silver Boot; Rodri received Golden Ball and Mbappé Golden Boot. This is a lead only: saved FIFA HTML response is a 200 client-rendered shell with no player/award text, and browser open returned zero lines. Do not treat Messi individual awards as independently verified here.

current_ballon_context.claim: Case-specific official 2026 men’s nominee list and regulations are already captured in the prior facts unit; that unit records Messi among the 30 nominees and the exact season period.
current_ballon_context.note: The official 2026 award is France Football’s men’s Ballon d’Or, distinct from FIFA World Cup individual awards.

sources.name: ap_final_report
sources.body_limit: Cloudflare challenge page; browser extraction used for the AP article text

limits: AFA’s 8 goals/4 assists and final result are direct, official-source text; the tournament falls within the contract window.
AP independently corroborates the score and Rodri award through browser extraction, but its HTTP receipt is a bot challenge.
Messi’s Silver Ball/Silver Boot remain unverified in publisher body; only FIFA page-discovery text reports them.
No MLS totals, October 2026 stats, October 6 farewell, probability, ranking, or trade included.
